g.text: Instance 1 | Interim comparison at 5.3 million steps
512 trials per case | T = 5.3 million CA steps | Minimum persistence: 100,000 steps
Retrospective: only intervals persisting through T count; the same unit and vector must persist.
Bands: pointwise 95% Wilson intervals. Persistence is inferred from FSM output events.
